message.content:
I don’t have access to live clock data, so I can’t give you the exact current time right now.  
If you need the current time in New York City, you can:

1. **Check your device’s world clock** – most smartphones, tablets, and computers let you add New York (Eastern Time) as a separate clock.  
2. **Use an online time‑zone converter** – sites like [timeanddate.com](https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/) or the “World Clock” feature on Google will show the current time in New York.  
3. **Ask a voice assistant** – Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa, etc., can tell you “What time is it in New York?” instantly.

If you’d like me to calculate sunrise/sunset times for a specific date in New York, just let me know the date!
